configure_coco_panoptic_train_dataset: set the train dataset name to coco_2017_train_panoptic_separated in the dataloader config
configure_coco_panoptic_test_dataset: set the test dataset name to coco_2017_val_panoptic_separated in the dataloader config
configure_coco_panoptic_evaluators: configure COCOEvaluator, SemSegEvaluator, and COCOPanopticEvaluator for the separated panoptic dataset
disable_empty_filter: set filter_empty to False on the train dataset to include empty annotations
review_dataloader_config: review the dataloader configuration that overrides coco base settings for panoptic separated evaluation
